referenceMachine.captureNote: Captured after the initial run on the same host; original harness did not record machine metadata.

method.loadMs: Graph file read + gzip decompression + JSON parse. Filesystem cache uncontrolled.
method.peakProcessRssMiB: Node resourceUsage.maxRSS / 1024, whole child process including loader and loaded graph.
method.cancelLatencyMs: Time from timer callback abort to generator ending. Timer scheduling delay was not recorded.
method.attemptedVsCompleted: Terminal and approximately one-second snapshots recorded both. Exact time all starts were attempted was not measured.
method.witnessRecovery: Not measured. Output counts do not establish recovery of the independently proven route.
method.cpuMs: User + system process CPU measured over the generator, including consumer.

limitations: The 10-second observation window is descriptive and is not an application timeout or performance acceptance gate.
Pure-engine resource measurement excludes backend/browser/result retention and is not full-app memory.
Published pilot inputs inherit retired mountain admission, fixed-distance geometry pruning and finite source coverage.
The original harness was temporary. Use the checked-in run-engine.mjs for reproduction with additional witness instrumentation; its measurements are separate from this original capture.
